Transitions Level 2 · Lead My IEP

Last Time · Answers

Check: Last Time

🧱 A boundary = a line a person sets to

feel safe (body, stuff, space, time).

🗣 “Okay, no problem.” Wait, or ask

someone else.

🔴 Stop. It's their private stuff.

Transitions Level 2 · Lead My IEP

Learn

Learn: What Is an IEP?

IEP = my plan for school.

It lists my goals

🎯 and the supports that

help me.

My team meets every year.

I am part of the team!

Transitions Level 2 · Lead My IEP

Learn

Learn: Who Is on My

Team?

🙋 👨‍👩‍👧 My family

Me  · 

🧑‍🏫 My teachers  ·  My case manager

🗣 Other helpers (speech, job coach)

Transitions Level 2 · Lead My IEP

Learn

Words to Know

⭐ Strength = something I do well.

🎯 Goal = something I want to learn or

do.

🧰 Support (accommodation) = a

change that helps me learn or work.
